description: Turret Enhanced shows its azimuth tape, elevation ladder, target grid and target-marking actions to any crew member in a gunner view, so door gunners and ground gunners get a drone camera overlay. This limits manned vehicles to the seats that get the UKSF camera compass: an aircraft pilot seat with a pilot camera or an aircraft turret with OpticsIn. UAV gunners keep it. Its own north marker is never drawn, because the UKSF camera compass draws one and the forced Fat_Lurch_ShowNorth setting does not load in single player.
